full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 44
Daily Agenda
Federal Parliament, Nepal
Tuesday, Bhadra 2, 2083
11:00 AM
Ministry-wise Discussion
Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation, Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
1. The concerned Minister will answer oral questions related to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forest and Environment.
Presentation of Annual Report
2. The "Seventh Annual Report of the Tharu Commission (2081 Shrawan - 2082 Ashadh)" will be presented by the Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, on behalf of the Right Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah.
Legislative Work
3. Honorable Minister of Foreign Affairs, Shishir Khanal, will present the proposal "Consider the Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present the proposal "Consider the Mediation (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
Treaty-related Work
4. Honorable Minister of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present the proposal "Consider the ratification of the United Nations Convention against Transnational Organized Crime and its Protocol to Prevent, Suppress and Punish Trafficking in Persons, Especially Women and Children" and "Consider the ratification of the Convention on the Law of the Sea and the Convention on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction".
Pan Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
